item.title: Trump diz ter assinado proclamação para lidar com os preços “excessivamente” altos da carne bovina
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, assinou nesta quarta-feira uma proclamação para aumentar temporariamente a quantidade de carne bovina magra importada, segundo a Casa Branca.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, assinou nesta quarta-feira uma proclamação para aumentar temporariamente a quantidade de carne bovina magra importada, segundo a Casa Branca. A proclamação divulgada pela Casa Branca afirmou que a medida visava enfrentar os preços da carne bovina, que “aumentaram excessivamente” para os consumidores dos EUA. A American Farm Bureau Federation, a principal associação agrícola do país, enviou uma carta a Trump afirmando que a redução das tarifas “prejudicaria os pecuaristas americanos”. Trump sugeriu na semana passada que tomaria essa medida, o que gerou forte oposição imediata por parte de grupos agrícolas e pecuários dos EUA. Os consumidores norte-americanos têm enfrentado preços recordes da carne bovina este ano, já que a seca e os incêndios florestais reduziram o estoque de gado ao menor nível em 75 anos. Trump havia imposto restrições à importação de gado do México para combater a propagação da mosca-da-bicheira, segundo a proclamação. Nesta semana, os EUA iniciaram uma reabertura gradual de alguns portos de gado ao longo de sua fronteira sul. A cota de importação de carne bovina magra isenta da tarifa adicional será ampliada em 300 mil toneladas, segundo a proclamação. No Brasil, a Associação Brasileira das Indústrias Exportadoras de Carnes (Abiec) disse estar acompanhando a medida. "A iniciativa pode representar uma oportunidade para o setor brasileiro, embora o Brasil não seja o único país que poderá se beneficiar da ampliação", disse a Abiec em nota.

item.title: Prudential posts 8% rise in first-half new business profit, expands share buyback
item.description: Insurer Prudential , reported first-half new business profit largely in line with market expectations on Thursday, driven by strong growth in Hong Kong, Malaysia and Singapore, and expanded its ongoing share repurchase program by $300 million.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Insurer Prudential (PRU.L) , reported first-half new business profit largely in line with market expectations on Thursday, driven by strong growth in Hong Kong, Malaysia and Singapore, and expanded its ongoing share repurchase program by $300 million. New business profit, a measure of the lifetime profits expected from policies sold, rose to $1.38 billion for the six months ended June 30, 8% higher than last year on a constant exchange rate basis, just shy of the Visible Alpha consensus estimate of $1.39 billion. In Hong Kong, new business profit rose 8% on a constant exchange rate (CER) basis to $581 million in the first half, while Malaysia posted a 46% increase to $70 million. In mainland China, new business profit slipped 4% on a CER basis to $159 million, hurt by a shift in sales towards lower-profit products and regulatory changes affecting bank distribution costs. Excluding the Chinese mainland, new business profit grew by 10% on a CER basis. Earlier this month, shares of Hong Kong insurers fell on reports that China had begun [USN:L1N443019 TEXT:"levying a 20% personal income tax"] on returns from Hong Kong insurance policies, fuelling concerns over Beijing's crackdown on cross-border investment channels and its impact on demand from mainland Chinese customers. "While it is too early to assess whether recent commentary regarding the enforcement of existing rules will affect the buying behaviour of Chinese mainland customers, we remain confident in the structural growth prospects of our Hong Kong business," the insurer said. The London- and Hong Kong-listed insurer also announced an interim dividend of 8.88 cents per share, and increased its 2026 share repurchase program by $300 million to $1.5 billion.

item.title: UK's July auto output falls as weak exports and shutdowns weigh, industry data shows
item.description: British vehicle production fell 11.6% year-on-year in July as weaker exports and earlier summer maintenance shutdowns at some plants weighed on output, industry data showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British vehicle production fell 11.6% year-on-year in July as weaker exports and earlier summer maintenance shutdowns at some plants weighed on output, industry data showed on Thursday. The decline comes as carmakers grapple with softer demand and intensifying global competition, with the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT) urging the British government to improve competitiveness through changes to electric vehicle rules, lower energy costs and safeguards for automotive trade with Europe. Total vehicle production fell to 63,655 units in July, SMMT said, with car output slipping 10.6% from a year earlier. Overall British auto exports dropped 15.9% to 47,377 vehicles, as shipments to all major markets declined, including the European Union — Britain's largest export destination — China, the United States, Turkey and Japan. British commercial vehicle production plunged 34.4% to 1,888 units, with deliveries to domestic customers and export markets down 49.6% and 18.5%, respectively, the data showed. Electric and hybrid model manufacturing, however, rose 6.8% to 25,678 units during the month — the first increase of the year as electrified vehicles accounted for more than four in 10 cars built. Less than two weeks ago, Britain [USN:L8N446056 TEXT:"set out a range"] of options that could ease the pressure on car manufacturers to switch new sales to zero-emission vehicles, launching a review of existing targets that gradually phase out new petrol and diesel cars. "The rise in electrified vehicle production is encouraging, but long-term success depends on making the UK a more competitive place to make and sell vehicles," SMMT CEO Mike Hawes said in a statement. As of July, UK factories have produced just under 450,000 cars and commercial vehicles in 2026, down 8.1% from a year earlier.

item.title: 円は対ドルで159円前半、米指標受け米金利が上昇－債券は下落へ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 27日の外国為替市場で円は対ドルで159円台前半と、前日夕からやや円安で推移。米物価指標を受けて米金利が上昇し、ドル買いが優勢となっている。債券は下落して始まる見通し。日本銀行の氷見野良三副総裁の講演での発言次第では値動きが大きくなる可能性がある。

みずほ銀行国際為替部の長谷川久悟マーケット・エコノミストは、米個人消費支出（PCE）について「インフレの減速が遅いと市場は理解した」と述べた。ドルが買われたことについては、「強い結果になることは想定内だったため、ここまで反応するのは意外だった」と話した。

野村証券の後藤祐二朗チーフ為替ストラテジストは27日付のリポートで、氷見野副総裁の講演は「日銀政策及び円相場を占う上で重要度が高い」と指摘。2025年1月の利上げ前の講演で利上げの可能性を強くにじませた経緯があり、きょうも「同様の利上げ議論への前向きな姿勢が見られるかが焦点」だと述べた。

三菱UFJアセットマネジメントの小口正之エグゼクティブ・ファンドマネジャーは、日銀の利上げペースが早まるとの見方が債券相場の上値を抑えると指摘。きょうの氷見野副総裁の講演に続き、米ジャクソンホール会合や東京都区部の消費者物価指数（CPI）など金融政策を巡る材料が相次ぐことも、債券相場の重しになるとみている。

先物の夜間取引で中心限月9月物は26日の日中取引終値比6銭安の126円42銭で終えた。小口氏の先物の予想レンジは126円15銭－126円50銭、新発10年債利回りは2.880－2.925%（26日は2.885%で終了）。26日の米10年国債利回りは前日比2ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）高い4.65%程度。

item.title: Kyle Schwarber hits MLB-leading 40th homer as Phillies blank Mariners
item.description: Kyle Schwarber hit his major league-leading 40th home run of the season and Jesus Luzardo pitched seven scoreless innings as the Philadelphia Phillies defeated the host Seattle Mariners 6-0 Wednesday afternoon to salvage the finale of the three-game interleague series.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kyle Schwarber hit his major league-leading 40th home run of the season and Jesus Luzardo pitched seven scoreless innings as the Philadelphia Phillies defeated the host Seattle Mariners 6-0 Wednesday afternoon to salvage the finale of the three-game interleague series. Bryce Harper also went deep for the Phillies, who dropped the first two games of the series, ending a nine-game winning streak. Luzardo (12-5), who made his first All-Star Game this season, allowed just one hit, a two-out liner to left by Jhonny Pereda in the fifth inning. The left-hander walked three and struck out nine. Philadelphia's Tim Mayza and Jhoan Duran each pitched an inning of relief to complete the two-hit shutout. Duran allowed a leadoff single to Randy Arozarena in the ninth. The Phillies, who totaled just three runs over the previous two games, jumped on Mariners starter Bryan Woo (9-9) early, handing him his first home loss of the season after he entered 7-0 at T-Mobile Park. Schwarber led off the game with a double to center field and, an out later, Harper hit an opposite-field shot that hit off the top of the wall in left-center and bounced over. It was the 29th consecutive game in which Harper has reached base safely. The Phillies tacked on four more runs in the second. Bryson Stott led off with a double to left and Brandon Marsh walked. With one out, Justin Crawford grounded a run-scoring single to right. Schwarber then hit a 2-2 fastball 425 feet over the wall in right-center, a three-run shot to make it 6-0. Woo allowed six runs on five hits over four innings. The right-hander walked one and fanned five. The Phillies will continue their nine-game West Coast swing with three interleague games against the Los Angeles Angels starting Friday in Anaheim, Calif. They'll wrap up the trip with a three-game series against the Arizona Diamondbacks in Phoenix. The Diamondbacks are chasing Philadelphia for a National League wild-card berth. The Mariners, who wrapped up a 4-2 homestand, will hit the road for a six-game trip to Toronto and Boston starting Friday as they try to stay in the American League playoff chase. --Field Level Media

item.title: サウジアラムコ、ホルムズ海峡外での積み替えで原油供給拡大＝関係者
item.description:
Siyi Liu Chen Aizhu Florence Tan
[シンガポール ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Siyi Liu　Chen Aizhu　Florence Tan

[シンガポール ２６日 ロイター] - サウジアラビア国営石油会社サウジアラムコが９月積み出し分の原油について、ホルムズ海峡の外側での積み替えによる供給量を拡大していることが、事情に詳しい関係者４人の話で分かった。アラムコは今月、中国向けに少なくとも４００万バレルを販売している。

関係者によると、アラムコはアジアの買い手向けに、中質油「アラブ・ミディアム」と重質油「アラブ・ヘビー」の販売手続きを２週連続で開始した。積み荷はアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のフジャイラ沖またはオマーンのソハール沖で船舶間積み替え（ＳＴＳ）方式により引き渡される。いずれもホルムズ海峡の外側に位置する。

こうした販売提案に先立ち、サウジ産原油４００万バレルを積載した超大型原油タンカー（ＶＬＣＣ）２隻が、ソハール沖でＳＴＳ方式により積み替えを実施し、中国に向けて出航したことが、ボルテクサおよびケプラーの船舶データで確認された。

データに基づくと、ＶＬＣＣ「シンガポール・プロスペリティ」は２２日ごろ、積載していたサウジ産原油をＶＬＣＣ「シン・フイ・ヤン」に移送。同船は９月１５日に中国東部の寧波港へ到着する見通しだ。

またＶＬＣＣ「アルジェリア・プロスペリティ」は２５日、積み荷をＶＬＣＣ「シン・ハン・ヤン」に移送した。同船は９月１２日に中国南部・湛江港へ到着する予定。ボルテクサのデータでは、両船の貨物はいずれも世界最大の石油精製会社である中国石油化工集団（シノペック）向け。シノペックはコメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。

さらにアラムコは先週、８月初旬にラス・タヌラ港での原油積み出しを再開した後、重質油を中心に少なくとも４００万バレルを中国石油天然気集団（ペトロチャイナ）および中国中化集団（シノケム）へ販売した。

アラムコはコメント要請に応じていない。

item.title: Justiça dos EUA recusa extradição de agente do ICE detido no Texas para o Minnesota
item.description: A Justiça Federal dos Estados Unidos negou nesta quarta-feira um pedido do Estado de Minnesota para obrigar o governador do Texas, Greg Abbott, a extraditar imediatamente um agente de imigração dos EUA preso, acusado de agressão por atirar na perna de um venezuelano durante a onda de deportações ocorrida no inverno passado em Minneapolis.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman, Andrew Goudsward
item.content:encoded: A Justiça Federal dos Estados Unidos negou nesta quarta-feira um pedido do Estado de Minnesota para obrigar o governador do Texas, Greg Abbott, a extraditar imediatamente um agente de imigração dos EUA preso, acusado de agressão por atirar na perna de um venezuelano durante a onda de deportações ocorrida no inverno passado em Minneapolis. A decisão abre caminho para que Christian Castro, o agente da Agência de Imigração e Alfândega dos EUA (ICE, na sigla em inglês) preso pelos Texas Rangers em cumprimento a um mandado judicial de Minnesota, seja libertado na quinta-feira, data em que expira o prazo de 90 dias de detenção para quem aguarda extradição, de acordo com a lei do Texas. Autoridades de Minnesota haviam argumentado no tribunal que Castro, detido desde 29 de maio na cidade fronteiriça de Brownsville, no Texas, na Costa do Golfo, representa risco de fuga caso seja solto. Castro é procurado em Minnesota para responder a quatro acusações de agressão em segundo grau com arma perigosa e a uma acusação de falsa denúncia de crime. Castro atirou e feriu Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis, em 14 de janeiro, no auge da campanha de deportação do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, em Minneapolis, e é acusado de ter inventado um motivo para usar força letal contra um homem desarmado, segundo os promotores. Castro não foi encontrado para comentar o caso e não ficou claro se ele contratou um advogado. A operação de deportação em Minneapolis, chamada de “Operação Metro Surge”, gerou semanas de manifestações e confrontos entre manifestantes e agentes do ICE, nos quais oficiais de imigração mataram a tiros dois cidadãos norte-americanos. O caso envolvendo o tiroteio contra Sosa-Celis, um cidadão venezuelano, tem permanecido como um ponto de atrito entre os governadores do Texas e de Minnesota em relação ao controle da imigração. Abbott, um republicano, tem apoiado as medidas de deportação de Trump, enquanto os líderes democratas de Minnesota, incluindo o governador Tim Walz, condenaram o aumento das patrulhas armadas do ICE em Minneapolis e em outras cidades promovido por Trump. Em um documento judicial apresentado na segunda-feira, Abbott questionou se Castro deveria ser classificado como foragido e, portanto, sujeito a extradição, uma vez que ele não fugiu de Minnesota, mas foi transferido de volta para sua base no Texas pelo Departamento de Segurança Interna dos EUA (DHS, na sigla em inglês), órgão ao qual o ICE é vinculado, após o tiroteio. As autoridades de Minnesota rebateram que a questão de como ou por que Castro acabou no Texas é irrelevante, e que a Constituição dos EUA e a lei federal exigem que os Estados extraditem pessoas procuradas por crimes cometidos em outra Unidade. Apoiando as autoridades do Texas um dia após ouvir os argumentos do caso, o juiz federal Fernando Rodriguez Jr. considerou não haver comprovação de que Abbott tenha recusado o pedido de extradição. Para o juiz, ele apenas ainda não havia tomado uma decisão. Rodriguez concluiu que a lei não exige um prazo para a entrega de um foragido. Rodriguez reconheceu a possibilidade de que Castro possa tentar fugir dos EUA após sua libertação e “dificultar os esforços do Ministério Público de Minnesota”, mas considerou que a possibilidade não altera suas conclusões jurídicas.

item.title: NFL ends Pro Bowl, selection of 'best of the best' to continue
item.description: The NFL is ending the Pro Bowl Games after repeated format changes to its annual all-star event.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The NFL is ending the Pro Bowl Games after repeated format changes to its annual all-star event. Beginning with the 2026 season, 88 Pro Bowlers will be selected but the NFL no longer plans to stage an AFC-NFC game, a flag-football matchup or an accompanying series of competitions. The players chosen will instead be invited to next year's Super Bowl site in Los Angeles for an in-person celebration in February. The biggest change beyond eliminating the event itself involves alternates. Only the original 88 selections will be named Pro Bowlers and no alternates will be added, ending a system that expanded the list when players withdrew because of injuries, Super Bowl commitments or other reasons. Voting remains split with fans, players and coaches accounting for one-third of the selection process. "The Pro Bowl has always been about recognizing the players who distinguish themselves as the very best in the NFL," NFL executive vice president Peter O'Reilly said Wednesday. "A Pro Bowl selection will return to its original purpose, honoring the best of the best. We want that distinction to carry even greater meaning for the players, their families, their clubs and our fans." The NFL reworked the event through multiple iterations in recent years as interest in the traditional tackle all-star game declined. The AFC-NFC format was temporarily replaced by a fantasy football style draft in 2014 before later returning in 2017. The Pro Bowl moved away from longtime host Hawaii after the 2016 edition. A tackle football game was last played in 2022, and rebranded as the Pro Bowl Games for a 2023 debut with skills competitions and flag football. This past season, the Pro Bowl Games were moved to the Tuesday before the Super Bowl in San Francisco. League officials said discussions with players helped drive the latest change, citing concerns that repeated selections for replacement had diluted an honor that can have contractual and legacy implications. --Field Level Media

item.title: 日本株続伸へ、米エヌビディアの強気見通し好感－AI・半導体関連買い
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 27日の日本株相場は続伸する見込み。米半導体大手エヌビディアの強気な業績見通しを好感する。

エヌビディアのコレット・クレス最高財務責任者（CFO）は決算発表後の電話会見で「2028年度の売上高は約70%増加すると予想している」と述べ、同社株は米国市場の時間外取引で上昇した。日本でも株価指数への寄与度が大きいAI・半導体関連が買われやすい。

きょうは日本銀行の氷見野良三副総裁が講演と記者会見を予定している。9月利上げの観測が一段と強まれば、銀行など金融株に追い風となる。

item.title: 米郵便投票の新規則差し止め、民主党系州と投票権擁護団体が再度提訴
item.description:
Nate Raymond
[ボストン ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nate Raymond

[ボストン ２６日 ロイター] - 米野党民主党が主導する州と投票権擁護団体は２６日、郵便投票に関してトランプ大統領の指示に基づいて米郵政公社（ＵＳＰＳ）が導入を進める新たな要件適用の差し止めを求め、東部マサチューセッツ州のボストン連邦地裁に訴訟を再度提起した。民主党系の州司法長官ら２３州とコロンビア特別区、ペンシルベニア州知事で構成される原告団のほか、投票権擁護団体が関連訴訟を起こした。

トランプ大統領は３月に郵便投票の本人確認や管理強化を目的とした大統領令を発出。ＵＳＰＳがまだ最終規則を策定していなかった段階で、同じ原告団が提起した訴訟について連邦地裁からいったん差し止め命令を獲得したが、連邦最高裁は最終規則が出る前の訴えは手続き上認められないとしてこの差し止め命令を取り消していた。

その後、ＵＳＰＳが２１日に最終規則を発表すると、原告団が改めて訴訟に動いた形だ。

一方、今回の訴訟提起まで、投票権擁護団体が起こした関連訴訟でタルワニ連邦地裁判事が出した別の差し止め命令により、ＵＳＰＳは新規則を実施できない状態にあったが、タルワニ判事は州側が提訴した直後にこの命令を取り消した。判事は連邦最高裁の判断を踏まえると差し止め命令を維持できないと述べた。

ただ投票権擁護団体は修正訴状を速やかに提出し、州側とともに新規則の実施を再び阻止するための一時的な差し止め命令を求めた。

タルワニ判事は、改めて出された差し止め請求に対する回答をトランプ政権に対し２７日正午までに提出するよう命じた。また規則を無期限に停止する仮差し止め命令を発令するかどうかを審理するため、９月３日に審問を開く予定だ。

発表された新規則では、各州に対し郵便投票の対象者リストをＵＳＰＳへ提供することを求めるほか、発送用および返送用の投票用封筒全てに固有のバーコード表示を義務付ける。規則に適合しない投票用紙や、名簿に掲載されていない有権者に関連する投票用紙については、ＵＳＰＳが配達を拒否できるとしている。

民主党系の州はこの新要件が選挙直前の数週間で大きな負担になると主張し、新たな封筒や機器の購入に加え、新システムの構築と職員研修が必要になると指摘。ニューヨーク州のジェームズ司法長官は「新方針は混乱と不必要なコストを生み、有権者にとって容認できないリスクをもたらすだけだ。われわれはこれを阻止するため提訴する」と述べた。

原告側の主張に基づくと、ＵＳＰＳには郵便投票の資格要件を連邦レベルで定める権限はなく、この規則は有権者の権利を保護する連邦法や、選挙運営権限を州に認めた合衆国憲法に反する。また新規則によって有権者の投票権が奪われる恐れがあるという。

訴状によると、２０２４年の選挙ではＵＳＰＳが約１億票の投票用紙を取り扱い、全米有権者の約３０％が郵便投票を利用した。

ＵＳＰＳはコメント要請に回答していない。

item.title: Qantas upbeat on revenue, brings forward A380 exit as profit falls
item.description: Australia's Qantas Airways gave an upbeat revenue outlook on Thursday and said it would begin retiring its Airbus A380 superjumbos in 2028 after posting a 14% fall in annual underlying profit as fuel prices spiked.
item.dc:creator: Sameer Manekar, Julie Zhu
item.content:encoded: Australia's Qantas Airways (QAN.AX) gave an upbeat revenue outlook on Thursday and said it would begin retiring its Airbus (AIR.PA) A380 superjumbos in 2028 after posting a 14% fall in annual underlying profit as fuel prices spiked. The country's flag carrier said it was in talks with Airbus and Boeing (BA.N) about converting 20 options to firm orders for A350s and 787s from 2030 because it would start replacing the superjumbos about four years earlier than previously planned. "The A380s are now no longer in production, and so the cost of those aircraft over time will increase in terms of maintenance, but also the cost of disruptions that will come are also going to increase," Qantas CEO Vanessa Hudson told reporters. The new order would be separate from the carrier's plans for "Project Sunrise" non-stop flights from Sydney to London and New York on a fleet of 12 specially designed long-range A350-1000s that will begin to arrive from next year. Hudson's comments came after the airline reported underlying profit before tax of A$2.06 billion ($1.48 billion) for the year ended June 30, slightly ahead of the Visible Alpha consensus estimate of A$2.00 billion. Hudson said the year was "defined by two very different operating environments" as robust travel demand through much of the year collided with a surge in fuel costs driven by the Middle East conflict that reduced second-half earnings by A$420 million. Higher fares, a reduction in domestic capacity and redeploying aircraft to stronger international routes only partially offset the headwinds from rising fuel costs. Despite easing tensions in the Middle East, Qantas forecast jet fuel prices to remain elevated through the first half of the 2027 financial year, projecting net fuel cost to be about A$3.6 billion, compared with A$2.6 billion spent in the six months ending December 2025. Nevertheless, the carrier projected domestic and international total unit revenue growth between 8% and 10% in the first half of the year, higher than the Visible Alpha consensus on both measures. Shares in Qantas jumped 3% in early trading to their highest in a week, compared with a 0.4% decline in the ASX200 benchmark index (.AXJO) as of 0020 GMT. The airline said travel demand remained resilient, though it forecast domestic capacity would decline 3% in the first half while international capacity would rise 2%. Qantas declared a final dividend of 19.8 Australian cents per share, and decided to scrap its A$150 million share buyback program announced in February, which it never began after the outbreak of the Iran war. "Qantas delivered resilient earnings, maintained balance sheet strength, continued returning capital to shareholders and provided a constructive outlook," Jefferies analysts said in a note. ($1 = 1.3935 Australian dollars)

item.title: Former JPMorgan executive Staley says he shared confidential bank information with Epstein
item.description: Former JPMorgan Chase executive Jes Staley told U.S. lawmakers he repeatedly shared confidential and market-sensitive bank information with Jeffrey Epstein and was at one point named as a trustee of his estate, according to a transcript released by the U.S. Congress House Oversight Committee.
item.dc:creator: Nupur Anand
item.content:encoded: Former JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) executive Jes Staley told U.S. lawmakers he repeatedly shared confidential and market-sensitive bank information with Jeffrey Epstein and was at one point named as a trustee of his estate, according to a transcript released by the U.S. Congress House Oversight Committee. These admissions come as lawmakers probe the late convicted sex offender's ties with political and business elites. Staley appeared before the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform in July as part of its investigation into Epstein and his associate Ghislaine Maxwell. Transcripts from the meeting were released on Wednesday. In the closed-door, voluntary interview conducted on July 24, Staley said [USN:L4N43O1S5 TEXT:"he divulged"] to Epstein the bank's communications with the Federal Reserve during the 2008 financial crisis, a figure of $44 billion in private bank inflows over two weeks, his own compensation, and details of pending deals. Staley also admitted to sharing other confidential information about JPMorgan with Epstein, according to the transcript. Lawmakers also questioned him about communications in which he discussed matters including his compensation, client relationships and developments related to his eventual move to Barclays. Staley defended the exchanges, saying he believed he had the authority to share information when he considered it appropriate. He has maintained he had a close professional relationship with Epstein, but was unaware of his crimes. He also testified that he informed Epstein about the bank's concerns over his large cash withdrawals and told him he had been designated a high-risk client. JPMorgan declined to comment. Staley's lawyers did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Staley spent more than three decades at JPMorgan, where he ran the private bank and asset-management business for which Epstein was a client, before leading Barclays from 2015 until his resignation in 2021. Separately, he also confirmed he had been appointed to a role in connection with Epstein's estate years after his 2008 conviction. He said he signed documents related to the Epstein trust in 2014 and a trust amendment in 2015, but later declined to serve because he did not want to be associated with the estate and did not receive any compensation for it. The disclosures add new detail to scrutiny of the relationship between Staley and Epstein, the disgraced financier and convicted sex offender who died in jail in 2019 while awaiting trial on federal sex-trafficking charges. He had extensive ties to many prominent people in politics, finance, academia and business, including U.S. President Donald Trump. The oversight committee has interviewed figures such as former President Bill Clinton, current Commerce Secretary and former Cantor Fitzgerald CEO Howard Lutnick and Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates, as well as [USN:L4N43W1SQ TEXT:"Goldman Sachs"] senior counsel Kathy Ruemmler.

item.title: トランプ氏、米電力網への一部外国製機器導入禁止令に署名
item.description: [２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２６日、国家非常事態を宣言し、国内電力網で一部の外国製機器の使用を禁止する大統領令に署名した。ホワイトハウスが明らかにした。

国家安全保障上の脆弱性をもたらす恐れのある外国製の大規模電力システムによる「異例かつ極めて深刻な外国からの脅威」が理由だとしている。

今回の大統領令は中国がもたらす技術的脅威に対処する米国の取り組みの最新事例となる。

ロイターは昨年、米国の専門家らが、一部の中国製太陽光発電用インバーターから、製品文書に記載されていない不正な通信機器を発見したと報じた。

ホワイトハウスによると、この大統領令に基づき、サイバーセキュリティーや運用上のリスクをもたらす可能性のあるソフトウエアやデジタル機能を含む、特定の外国製大規模電力システム用電気機器について、米国内での購入や設置が禁止される。

item.title: Petróleo fecha em baixa após sessão volátil enquanto investidores avaliam negociações sobre Ormuz
item.description: Os preços do petróleo fecharam em baixa após uma sessão volátil nesta quarta-feira, enquanto os investidores acompanhavam as negociações entre o Irã e Omã sobre o Estreito de Ormuz e um aumento menor do que o esperado nos estoques de petróleo bruto dos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Georgina Mccartney
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo fecharam em baixa após uma sessão volátil nesta quarta-feira, enquanto os investidores acompanhavam as negociações entre o Irã e Omã sobre o Estreito de Ormuz e um aumento menor do que o esperado nos estoques de petróleo bruto dos EUA. Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam em queda de 0,84%, a US$87,84 o barril. Os contratos futuros do petróleo West Texas Intermediate fecharam em queda de 0,16%, a US$82,23. Durante o pregão, ambas as referências caíram para seus níveis mais baixos desde 10 de agosto, com a esperança de um aumento no tráfego pelo estreito. Os contratos reduziram as quedas depois que dados oficiais sobre os estoques de petróleo mostraram que os estoques de petróleo bruto dos EUA aumentaram menos do que o esperado na semana passada. Os estoques de petróleo bruto aumentaram em 95.000 barris, para 428,9 milhões de barris, na semana encerrada em 21 de agosto, em comparação com as expectativas dos analistas em uma pesquisa da Reuters, que apontavam para um aumento de 597.000 barris. IRÃ E OMÃ TRABALHAM NOS DETALHES Analistas afirmaram que as negociações entre o Irã e Omã mudaram o clima no mercado. “O mercado passou de precificar uma alta probabilidade de interrupção prolongada e nova escalada para precificar uma reabertura parcial, acordos de transporte negociados e um risco menor de novo confronto militar”, disse Ole Hansen, chefe de estratégia de commodities do Saxo Bank. “Um acordo confiável que restaure rapidamente o tráfego no Estreito de Ormuz poderia eliminar mais uma camada do prêmio geopolítico.” O Irã e Omã estão trabalhando nos detalhes do acordo sobre o estreito, afirmou uma fonte iraniana de alto escalão nesta quarta-feira, depois que a Guarda Revolucionária do Irã informou que os dois países haviam chegado a um acordo sobre como compartilhar a via navegável e suas receitas. Até que os ataques aéreos dos EUA e de Israel deram início a uma guerra no Irã no final de fevereiro, o Estreito de Ormuz era a rota por onde passava cerca de um quinto do abastecimento global de petróleo e gás. Apenas cinco navios de carga transitaram pela via navegável na terça-feira, segundo dados preliminares da empresa de rastreamento de navios Kpler, uma queda em relação à média de 15 nos últimos 10 dias e bem abaixo dos níveis pré-guerra. Os esforços para chegar a um acordo mais amplo sobre o conflito com o Irã também continuam. O Paquistão e o Irã fizeram “progressos significativos” nas negociações, afirmou o ministro do Interior do Paquistão na terça-feira, ao final de uma visita a Teerã. O primeiro-ministro do Catar, Mohammed bin Abdulrahman al-Thani, visitará Teerã na quinta-feira para se reunir com autoridades iranianas e discutir formas de diminuir as tensões, informou nesta quarta-feira o porta-voz do Ministério das Relações Exteriores, Majed Al Ansari, no X.

item.title: US judge refuses to force extradition of jailed ICE agent from Texas to Minnesota
item.description: A federal judge on Wednesday denied a request by Minnesota to force Texas Governor Greg Abbott to immediately extradite a jailed U.S. immigration agent facing assault charges for shooting a Venezuelan man in the leg during last winter's deportation surge in Minneapolis.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman, Andrew Goudsward
item.content:encoded: A federal judge on Wednesday denied a request by Minnesota to force Texas Governor Greg Abbott to immediately extradite a jailed U.S. immigration agent facing assault charges for shooting a Venezuelan man in the leg during last winter's deportation surge in Minneapolis. The ruling clears the way for Christian Castro, the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer arrested by Texas Rangers acting on a Minnesota court warrant, to be freed from custody on Thursday. That's when a 90-day detention limit for someone awaiting extradition under Texas law is due to expire. Minnesota authorities had argued in court that Castro, jailed in the Gulf Coast border city of Brownsville, Texas, since May 29, was a flight risk if he were released. Castro is wanted in Minnesota to face four counts of second-degree assault with a dangerous weapon and a charge of falsely reporting a crime. The charges stem from an incident in which Castro shot and wounded Julio Cesar Sosa-Celis on January 14, at the height of U.S. President Donald Trump's deportation campaign in Minneapolis, then fabricated his reason for using lethal force against a man who was unarmed, prosecutors say. Castro could not be reached for comment and it was unclear whether he has retained a lawyer. The Minneapolis deportation sweep, called Operation Metro Surge, drew weeks of demonstrations and confrontations between protesters and ICE agents in which immigration officers fatally shot two U.S. citizens. The case surrounding the shooting of Sosa-Celis, a Venezuelan national, has lingered as a flashpoint between the governors of Texas and Minnesota over immigration control. Abbott, a fellow Republican, has been a supporter of Trump's deportation efforts, while Minnesota's Democratic leaders, including Governor Tim Walz, have condemned Trump's surge of armed ICE patrols in Minneapolis and other cities. In a court brief filed on Monday, Abbott questioned whether Castro should be classified as a fugitive, and thus subject to extradition, because he did not flee Minnesota but rather was reassigned to his home base in Texas by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, ICE's parent agency, after the shooting. Minnesota authorities countered that the issue of how or why Castro ended up in Texas is immaterial, and that the U.S. Constitution and federal law require states to extradite people wanted for crimes in another state. Siding with Texas officials a day after hearing arguments in the case, U.S. District Judge Fernando Rodriguez Jr. ruled that Abbott had not been shown to have refused the extradition request, only that he had not yet made a decision. Rodriguez concluded that the law does not require Abbott to turn over a fugitive within a certain time frame. Rodriguez acknowledged the possibility that Castro could attempt to flee the U.S. after his release and "impose a hardship on Minnesota's prosecutorial efforts," but found that prospect does not alter his legal conclusions.

item.title: Eduardo Rodriguez helps Diamondbacks blank Cubs
item.description: Jordan Lawlar homered, Eduardo Rodriguez pitched seven scoreless innings, and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Chicago Cubs 2-0 to win the rubber game of a three-game series matching National League wild-card contenders in Phoenix on Wednesday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jordan Lawlar homered, Eduardo Rodriguez pitched seven scoreless innings, and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Chicago Cubs 2-0 to win the rubber game of a three-game series matching National League wild-card contenders in Phoenix on Wednesday afternoon. Lawlar lined an opposite field homer 364 feet over the right field fence leading off the sixth off Matthew Boyd (8-3) for the first run of the game, and Rodriguez won his fourth straight start. Rodriguez (14-4) gave up two hits and three walks, and he tied a season high with nine strikeouts. He extended his streak of scoreless innings to 17 2/3, since giving up two runs in the first inning of a 10-3 victory at Atlanta on Aug.15. Rodriguez, who has 17 quality starts, lowered his ERA to 2.50, third in the NL. Ryan Waldschmidt's sacrifice fly in the eighth made it 2-0 as the Cubs were shut out for 13th time. Juan Morillo pitched a 1-2-3 ninth for this second save after Brandyn Garcia pitched around a two-out walk in the eighth. Presumptive NL MVP favorite Pete Crow-Armstrong was 1 for 12 with a double and walk in the series. He struck out three times. Crow-Armstrong was the only Cub runner to get as far as third base after doubling to lead off the controversial sixth. He took third on a groundout before Rodriguez got Alex Bregman on a fly out to short. Crow-Armstrong broke toward home on a 2-1 pitch to Michael Busch, and replays showed Rodriguez stepped back off the rubber before delivering the ball. The Cubs lobbied for a balk, and the umpires huddled before deciding against a balk as Crow-Armstrong was restrained by third base coach Quentin Berry. Busch walked and Nico Hoerner struck out to end the inning. Lawlar and Geraldo Perdomo each had two of the D-backs' six hits. Arizona has won five of seven. The Cubs have lost five of seven, including consecutive road series at Seattle and Arizona. Boyd gave up three hits and two walks while striking out five in six innings. He beat the D-backs in Chicago on May 3, giving up two runs in six innings in an 8-4 victory. The Cubs did not have a hit off Rodriguez until Tyrone Taylor dropped a single over shortstop to open the fifth. Taylor stole second with one out but stayed there when Carson Kelly grounded out and Gabriel Arias struck out. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump says he signed proclamation to address 'unreasonably' high beef prices
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday signed a proclamation to temporarily increase the quantity of lean beef trimmings that are imported, according to the White House.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump on Wednesday signed a proclamation to temporarily increase the quantity of lean beef trimmings that are imported, according to the White House. The proclamation released by the White House said that the step aimed to address beef prices that have "increased unreasonably" for U.S. consumers. The American Farm Bureau Federation, the nation's top farm lobby, wrote to Trump in a letter that lightening the tariffs would "undermine America's ranchers." Trump suggested [USN:L8N44I0I6 TEXT:"last week"] that he would make the move, which drew immediate [USN:S0N43108W TEXT:"strong opposition"] from U.S. farm and ranch groups. U.S. consumers have faced [USN:L1N43218U TEXT:"record-high"] beef prices this year, as drought and wildfires have pushed cattle supplies to a 75-year low. Trump had imposed livestock import restrictions on Mexico to combat the spread of New World screwworm, the proclamation said. This week, the U.S. began a [USN:L6N44L0PW TEXT:"phased "]reopening of some livestock ports along its southern border. The quantity of trimmings imported with no above-quota tariff will be increased by 300,000 metric tons, the proclamation said.

item.title: STF proíbe cobrança de IPVA quando imposto já foi pago em outro estado
item.description: O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) declarou inconstitucional trecho de uma lei paulista que permitia cobrar o Imposto sobre a Propriedade de Veículos Automotores (IPVA) de veículos de locadoras quando o imposto já tivesse sido pago em outro Estado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) declarou inconstitucional trecho de uma lei paulista que permitia cobrar o Imposto sobre a Propriedade de Veículos Automotores (IPVA) de veículos de locadoras quando o imposto já tivesse sido pago em outro Estado. A norma de 2008 de São Paulo foi considerada como cobrança duplicada de tributo pelo plenário da corte de forma unânime, segundo comunicado do STF à imprensa. A decisão veio em ação aberta pela Confederação Nacional do Comércio de Bens, Serviços e Turismo (CNC) contra a lei paulista 13.296/2008. A regra de São Paulo considerava como fato gerador do IPVA a data em que um veículo registrado anteriormente em outro Estado fosse alugado ou colocado à disposição para locação em São Paulo. O STF considerou que o local de cobrança do IPVA deve ser o Estado onde o contribuinte mantém sua sede ou domicílio tributário, segundo o comunicado. No caso das locadoras, o veículo continua vinculado à empresa proprietária, e não à empresa que o aluga, afirma a nota do STF. A maior locadora de carros do Brasil é a Localiza (RENT3.SA) , que tem sede em Minas Gerais. A segunda maior do setor é a Movida (MOVI3.SA) , que tem sede em São Paulo.

item.title: NFL, NFLPA tighten discipline for repeat player-safety violations
item.description: The NFL and NFL Players Association said on Wednesday they will suspend players for one game if they commit three specified player-safety violations in a season, under an updated on-field accountability system aimed at reducing dangerous techniques.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The NFL and NFL Players Association said on Wednesday they will suspend players for one game if they commit three specified player-safety violations in a season, under an updated on-field accountability system aimed at reducing dangerous techniques. "Player safety is a shared responsibility," the league and union said in a joint statement. "These changes focus on the techniques that create the greatest risk while ensuring player, coach, and club accountability." The policy will place greater emphasis on hip-drop tackles, horse-collar tackles, launching, hits on defenseless players and blindside blocks. Players who commit three offences in any of these categories during a season will be suspended for one game, and these violations would carry over into subsequent seasons. Those who commit a single violation, however, will receive a portion of their fine back at the end of the season. According to the NFL and NFLPA, players will start the 2026 season with a clean slate, and there will be a faster and more transparent process for reducing the impact of prior offences. If a player commits a single offence in other eligible categories, they will have the entire fine amount returned at the end of the season. But the statement did not specify which categories are eligible. Coaches will be required to attend meetings with the league when their players approach the suspension threshold, while clubs with excessive health-and-safety violations could face increased financial penalties. Former NFL coach and player Ron Rivera will also join the pool of former players who oversee appeals hearings for on-field discipline.

item.title: Boeing posts contract jobs in labor dispute's latest escalation
item.description: Boeing posted contractor positions for engineering and technical roles on job sites on Tuesday, in what appears to be the latest escalation in its labor dispute with its white-collar union at its commercial airplane division.
item.dc:creator: Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: Boeing (BA.N) posted contractor positions for engineering and technical roles on job sites on Tuesday, in what appears to be the latest escalation in its labor dispute with its white-collar union at its commercial airplane division. After members of the Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace [USN:L6N44I098 TEXT:"overwhelmingly rejected Boeing's contract offer"] on Friday, the company said it would begin implementing a contingency plan in case of a strike after the current contract ends on October 6. A strike by SPEEA's 17,000 members could further delay certification of Boeing's 737 MAX 10 and 777-9, both of which are already years behind schedule. The certification delays have kept two of Boeing's most important new commercial jets from entering airline service, and a work stoppage by the engineers and technical workers responsible for that effort would be a blow to a company still recovering from quality and safety problems that followed a mid-air accident on a nearly new 737 MAX in January 2024. SPEEA is "hopeful" that the planemaker and its members can agree to a new four-year contract while avoiding a strike, union spokesman Bryan Corliss said. "It appears, however, that both sides are preparing for the possibility of a strike," he said. "In our case, that includes preparing information for our members on what they could expect should there be a work stoppage. For its part, Boeing seems to be looking for 17,000 individuals who don't care if they undercut worker solidarity." Boeing declined to comment on the contract job postings. "We want to reach an agreement before the current contract expires and look forward to finding a solution with SPEEA at the table. To protect business continuity and support our customers, we’re implementing our contingency planning which will leverage a wide range of qualified resources with a continued emphasis on safety and quality," a company spokesperson told Reuters. Boeing's last two major union contract negotiations ended in extended strikes — a [USN:L1N3M816J TEXT:"seven-week walkout"] by roughly 33,000 members of the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers (IAM) at Boeing's commercial airplanes division in 2024 and a [USN:L4N3WP1KK TEXT:"101-day strike"] by about 3,200 IAM members at Boeing's defense division in 2025. Bringing in thousands of contractors could set back progress Boeing has made addressing widespread quality and safety problems in its commercial aircraft production programs after the 737 MAX accident, Corliss said.

item.title: Café arábica fecha em baixa, recuando da máxima de seis semanas
item.description: Os contratos futuros do café arábica fecharam em baixa nesta quarta-feira, prolongando a retração do mercado em relação à máxima de seis semanas registrada na sessão anterior, enquanto os preços do açúcar apresentaram variações mistas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros do café arábica fecharam em baixa nesta quarta-feira, prolongando a retração do mercado em relação à máxima de seis semanas registrada na sessão anterior, enquanto os preços do açúcar apresentaram variações mistas. CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou em queda de 4%, a US$3,2215 por libra-peso, o menor nível desde 17 de agosto. O mercado havia atingido uma máxima de seis semanas, de US$3,4565, na terça-feira, antes de reverter o curso e fechar em baixa. * Operadores afirmaram que chuvas fracas estão previstas nas regiões cafeeiras do Brasil nos próximos dias, o que pode melhorar as perspectivas para a safra do próximo ano no maior produtor mundial. * A colheita deste ano no Brasil está agora começando a chegar ao fim. * A Cooxupé, maior cooperativa cafeeira do Brasil, informou na quarta-feira que seus produtores haviam colhido 87,5% da safra de 2026 até 21 de agosto, versus 81,1% registrados uma semana antes, mas abaixo dos 91,3% no mesmo período do ano passado. * O mercado permaneceu sustentado, no entanto, pela escassez de oferta no curto prazo, com os estoques certificados continuando a diminuir. * Os estoques na bolsa totalizavam 225.442 sacas em 25 de agosto, abaixo dos 229.214 sacas da semana anterior. No mesmo período do ano passado, os estoques totalizavam 729.934 sacas. * O café robusta registrou queda de 2,1%, para US$ 3.614 por tonelada métrica. AÇÚCAR * O açúcar bruto subiu 1,9%, para 17,59 centavos por libra-peso. * Os corretores afirmaram que o mercado foi sustentado por possíveis quedas na produção em vários países, em alguns casos ligadas ao fortalecimento do fenômeno climático El Niño. * A produtora francesa de açúcar Tereos espera que o calor extremo e a seca deste verão reduzam a produtividade da beterraba sacarina de seus produtores em mais de 20% em comparação com o ano passado, contribuindo para uma previsão de que a produção de açúcar da UE atinja o menor nível em 38 anos, informou a empresa na quarta-feira. * O açúcar branco recuou 0,6%, para US$514 a tonelada. (Reportagem de Nigel Hunt)

item.title: Trigo atinge limite diário de alta com preocupações sobre exportações do Mar Negro
item.description: Os contratos futuros do trigo mais negociados na bolsa de Chicago atingiram seu limite diário e estabeleceram novas máximas em vários anos nesta quarta-feira, após notícias de que a Rússia estaria considerando intensificar os ataques com mísseis balísticos contra Kiev.
item.dc:creator: Heather Schlitz
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros do trigo mais negociados na bolsa de Chicago atingiram seu limite diário e estabeleceram novas máximas em vários anos nesta quarta-feira, após notícias de que a Rússia estaria considerando intensificar os ataques com mísseis balísticos contra Kiev. Esse novo desdobramento reforçou um padrão de tensões crescentes que tem causado interrupções nas exportações de grãos do Mar Negro e mantido a incerteza quanto à disponibilidade global. Todos os contratos de milho e soja também atingiram máximas históricas durante a vigência do contrato, impulsionados pela alta dos futuros de trigo. O contrato de trigo mais negociado na bolsa de Chicago subiu 45 centavos, para US$7,4825 por bushel. Os ataques da Rússia poderiam incluir alvos no centro da cidade de Kiev e em infraestruturas críticas em outras partes da Ucrânia, após a conclusão de que os esforços para negociar um acordo de paz chegaram a um beco sem saída, informou a Bloomberg News nesta quarta-feira, citando três pessoas próximas ao Kremlin. A reportagem afirmou que as estruturas de negociação entraram efetivamente em colapso, enquanto o presidente Vladimir Putin continuava pouco propenso a encerrar a guerra em resposta às sanções ou aos ataques ucranianos a refinarias e redes logísticas russas. A paralisação virtual dos embarques de grãos nos portos russos e ucranianos do Mar Negro, devido a ataques recíprocos nas últimas semanas, gerou dúvidas sobre os fluxos de milho ucraniano e, particularmente, de trigo russo. O contrato mais negociado de milho subiu 13 centavos, para US$5,365 por bushel, impulsionado pela alta nos futuros de trigo e pelas expectativas de baixa produtividade da safra de milho dos EUA. O contrato de referência havia subido anteriormente para US$ 5,3875 por bushel, seu maior nível desde o verão de 2023, superando a máxima de três anos registrada na terça-feira. A soja subiu 28,25 centavos, para US$12,66 o bushel, à medida que a China continuou comprando soja dos EUA e os preços do petróleo se recuperaram.

item.title: クラウドストライク株急伸、売上高見通しが予想超え－AI脅威で需要増
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米サイバーセキュリティー・サービス会社クラウドストライク・ホールディングスの株価が26日の時間外取引で上昇した。決算発表で示した通期売上高見通しがアナリスト予想を上回った。AIによる脅威を背景に、サイバーセキュリティーの需要が引き続き旺盛であることを示している。

発表資料によると、８－10月（第3四半期）の売上高は最大15億3000万ドル（約2400億円）になる見通し。ブルームバーグが集計したアナリスト予想平均は15億2000万ドルだった。通期売上高は59億9000万－60億1000万ドルを見込み、市場予想の59億4000万ドルを上回った。

株価は引け後の時間外取引で一時12%上昇した。今年に入り一時62%高となっている。

5－7月（第2四半期）の売上高は14億7000万ドル。ブルームバーグがまとめたアナリスト予想平均は14億4000万ドルだった。調整後1株利益は0.31ドルで、市場予想の0.29ドルを上回った。クラウドストライクは1株を4株にする株式分割を7月に実施している。

5－7月期の年間経常収益（ARR）は58億4000万ドルだった。アナリスト予想平均は57億9000万ドル。ARRは、ソフトウエア企業がサブスクリプション収入を測る際に広く使う指標で、クラウドストライクは投資家への説明で重要な指標と位置付けてきた。

AIを利用したハッキングの広がりが追い風になるとみられるハイテク株が買われる流れを受け、サイバーセキュリティー関連株全般が上昇している。

原題：CrowdStrike Stock Jumps After Annual Revenue Outlook Beats (1)（抜粋）

item.title: Nvidia prevê receita trimestral acima das estimativas
item.description: A Nvidia previu receita trimestral acima das estimativas de Wall Street nesta quarta-feira, um sinal de que as grandes empresas de tecnologia ainda estão investindo pesado em chips para impulsionar suas ambições em inteligência artificial, mesmo enquanto muitas delas competem para construir os seus próprios.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Nvidia previu receita trimestral acima das estimativas de Wall Street nesta quarta-feira, um sinal de que as grandes empresas de tecnologia ainda estão investindo pesado em chips para impulsionar suas ambições em inteligência artificial, mesmo enquanto muitas delas competem para construir os seus próprios. A empresa prevê receita de US$108 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, com uma margem de erro de 2%, em comparação com a estimativa média dos analistas de US$104,19 bilhões, segundo dados compilados pela LSEG. A Nvidia afirmou que não incluiu em suas projeções nenhuma venda de chips para data centers provenientes da China. Os resultados da Nvidia, uma das empresas mais valiosas do mundo, são considerados um indicador para o mercado de IA, já que seus chips alimentam a maioria dos principais centros de dados e modelos avançados de IA em todo o mundo. O relatório surge semanas depois que empresas, incluindo Microsoft e Meta — dois dos maiores clientes da Nvidia — reforçaram as expectativas de que as grandes empresas de tecnologia gastariam mais de US$730 bilhões em infraestrutura de IA este ano, uma quantia sem precedentes que representa um grande aumento em relação ao investimento de US$400 bilhões do ano passado. No entanto, uma parcela crescente dos gastos previstos pelas empresas de tecnologia está sendo direcionada para o desenvolvimento interno de chips, visando reduzir sua dependência dos processadores da Nvidia, que são caros e têm disponibilidade limitada. O papel da Nvidia no complexo ecossistema de financiamento do boom da IA também passou a ser alvo de escrutínio após a empresa concordar em garantir alguns negócios no âmbito de uma nova parceria com seis grandes instituições financeiras, que visa arrecadar mais de US$500 bilhões para infraestrutura de IA. Com o uso crescente de IA para automatizar tarefas e responder a perguntas, os processadores gráficos da Nvidia enfrentam uma concorrência cada vez maior de processadores centrais e chips personalizados mais adequados para lidar com esse processo — conhecido como inferência. As rivais Intel e AMD também estão de olho no mercado de inferência, e várias empresas chinesas, incluindo a Baidu (9888.HK) ;, já produzem seus próprios chips para essas tarefas. A Nvidia percebeu isso. Em março, a empresa apresentou um novo processador central e sistema de IA baseado em tecnologia licenciada da startup Groq, focada em inferência, em um acordo de US$17 bilhões, combinando os chips da Groq com sua futura plataforma Vera Rubin. O domínio da empresa como líder de mercado em IA foi reforçado no início deste mês, quando o presidente-executivo da SpaceX, Elon Musk, afirmou que a empresa de foguetes usará exclusivamente hardware da Nvidia. A Nvidia declarou que a oportunidade de receita para seus chips de IA pode ultrapassar US$1 trilhão até 2027, o dobro da oportunidade de US$500 bilhões até 2026 que a Nvidia citou para seus chips Blackwell e Rubin. (Por Anhata Rooprai)

item.title: Asesores crean comité para organizar a los acreedores comerciales de Venezuela
item.description: Asesores legales y financieros han creado un comité para reunir a las empresas con reclamaciones comerciales pendientes contra Venezuela, de cara a la reestructuración de la deuda prevista por el país, según informaron los propios asesores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Asesores legales y financieros han creado un comité para reunir a las empresas con reclamaciones comerciales pendientes contra Venezuela, de cara a la reestructuración de la deuda prevista por el país, según informaron los propios asesores. Registrada a principios de este mes, la iniciativa, que se anunciará formalmente el jueves, busca coordinar la participación de los acreedores comerciales en el proceso de reestructuración y, eventualmente, asegurar su representación en las negociaciones con Caracas. Venezuela anunció en mayo el inicio de una reestructuración de su deuda soberana y de la estatal PDVSA bajo el argumento de buscar un "alivio" de lo que considera obligaciones insostenibles. La mayoría de los analistas han estimado que las [USN:L6N41S10U TEXT:"deudas"] están entre 150.000 y 200.000 millones de dólares, pero el Financial Times informó que el país iba a revelar una deuda mayor de lo esperado, de 240.000 millones de dólares. Las obligaciones de Venezuela no solo incluyen los bonos soberanos y los de PDVSA, también abarcan laudos arbitrales derivados de las nacionalizaciones de empresas y préstamos bilaterales y multilaterales, así como deudas comerciales por retrasos de años en pagos a contratistas. El comité de acreedores comerciales busca empresas que se sumen a su iniciativa. Hasta el momento se estarían adhiriendo constructoras que participaron en obras de vivienda, vialidad, entre otras, según los asesores legales y financieros, que aspiran a que en septiembre haya más compañías como las que prestaron servicios al sector petrolero. "La idea es reunir a todas estas partes con intereses similares para lograr dos objetivos principales: resolver las reclamaciones de manera organizada mediante un proceso confiable para todos", dijo William Barry, presidente de Miller & Chevalier Chartered y asesor legal en una llamada. "Anticipamos que contaremos con miembros del comité que incluyan inversores que adquirieron deuda, aquellos con laudos arbitrales y, por último, los titulares directos de reclamaciones como las constructoras, las empresas de servicios petroleros, entre otros", agregó. El Ministerio de Comunicación de Venezuela, que gestiona todas las consultas de prensa del gobierno, no respondió de inmediato a la solicitud de comentarios. Los asesores no precisaron las empresas que ya están dentro del comité ni el monto de deudas que estarían manejando. Señalaron que las reclamaciones comerciales, que sumarían los laudos arbitrales, superan los 30.000 millones de dólares. "No necesitamos 30 reclamaciones para tener voz y voto en la mesa de negociación de la reestructuración. Solo necesitamos unas pocas de las más importantes, y ese es nuestro objetivo", dijo Brian Jarmain, director general de Aethel Partners, asesor financiero del comité, quien agregó que estarían buscando más constructoras de las que ya tienen, así como a las empresas del sector de servicios petroleros que "probablemente es el mayor acreedor comercial". Los asesores no han tenido contacto con Centerview que es el [USN:L8N425167 TEXT:"asesor financiero"] escogido para la reestructuración de deuda, sin una licitación formal. Venezuela no ha publicado estadísticas completas sobre su deuda en años. Caracas ha declarado que su objetivo es completar una evaluación exhaustiva sobre la sostenibilidad de la deuda, sin precisar cuándo.

item.title: BC anuncia leilão à vista de até US$1 bi e operação de swap reverso na 5ª-feira
item.description: O Banco Central anunciou na noite desta quarta-feira, por meio de dois comunicados, a realização na quinta-feira de dois leilões simultâneos, das 9h20 às 9h25, no mercado de câmbio, sendo um de venda à vista de dólares e outro de swap cambial reverso.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Banco Central anunciou na noite desta quarta-feira, por meio de dois comunicados, a realização na quinta-feira de dois leilões simultâneos, das 9h20 às 9h25, no mercado de câmbio, sendo um de venda à vista de dólares e outro de swap cambial reverso. Conforme o BC, no leilão à vista será ofertado US$1,0 bilhão. Nesta venda, na prática o BC retira dólares das reservas internacionais e vende aos dealers de câmbio. Já na operação de swap cambial reverso o BC negociará até 20.000 contratos, o que também equivale a US$1 bilhão. O efeito prático desta operação, porém, é equivalente a uma compra de dólares no mercado futuro. De acordo com o comunicado, na operação de swap reverso a data de início do contrato será 28 de agosto (sexta-feira, dia seguinte ao leilão), enquanto a data de vencimento será 1º de outubro deste ano. (Redação São Paulo)

item.title: Judge dismisses lawsuit by Elon Musk's X challenging New York hate speech law
item.description: A U.S. judge on Wednesday dismissed a lawsuit by Elon Musk's X seeking to void a New York state law requiring social media companies to disclose how they monitor hate speech, extremism, harassment, foreign political interference and disinformation.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Stempel
item.content:encoded: A U.S. judge on Wednesday dismissed a lawsuit by Elon Musk's X seeking to void a New York state law requiring social media companies to disclose how they monitor hate speech, extremism, harassment, foreign political interference and disinformation. U.S. District Judge John Cronan in Manhattan rejected X's [USN:L1N3SK0OS TEXT:"argument"] that the Stop Hiding Hate Act violated the U.S. Constitution's First Amendment by exposing it to lawsuits and big fines unless it disclosed "highly sensitive and controversial speech" that the state found objectionable. The judge said requiring X to report "purely factual and uncontroversial information" about its content moderation policies was reasonably related to New York's interest in letting people make informed choices about using social media. "Businesses always exercise their discretion, judgment, and opinions when deciding what goods or services to offer," Cronan wrote. "Burger King chooses to generally offer higher-calorie items than, say, Sweetgreen, but the disclosure of calorie information remains purely factual. So too here." The dismissal is with prejudice, meaning X cannot amend its complaint. X, formerly Twitter, is part of Musk's rocket and satellite company SpaceX (SPCX.O) . Neither lawyers for X nor SpaceX immediately responded to requests for comment. The office of New York Attorney General Letitia James defended the law. It did not immediately respond to similar requests for comment. Signed in December 2024 by Governor Kathy Hochul, the New York law required social media companies with at least $100 million of annual revenue to disclose how they eliminate hate on their platforms, and report their progress. Civil fines can reach $15,000 per violation per day. The law was written with help from the Anti-Defamation League. In [USN:L1N3WF17H TEXT:"seeking a dismissal"], James said the law helped consumers understand what to expect from social media, without blocking platforms from speaking out or exercising judgment when moderating content. Musk scrapped Twitter's content moderation policy after he bought that company in 2022. The world's richest person has described himself as a [USN:L6N3R10U9 TEXT:"free speech absolutist"].

item.title: No hay evidencia de nueva visa para turistas mexicanos en Argentina
item.description: Argentina no solicita una visa a ciudadanos mexicanos que ingresan al país con fines turísticos si su estancia no es mayor a 90 días y no contempla un cambio en esta disposición, dijo la embajada de Argentina en México, contrario a publicaciones en línea que lo anuncian como una nueva medida.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Argentina no solicita una visa a ciudadanos mexicanos que ingresan al país con fines turísticos si su estancia no es mayor a 90 días y no contempla un cambio en esta disposición, dijo la embajada de Argentina en México, contrario a publicaciones en línea que lo anuncian como una nueva medida. Ejemplos en Facebook dicen que el Gobierno argentino pedirá una visa de turista con costo de 263 dólares y una duración de cinco años. Según los mensajes, esto se debe al próximo Mundial de la FIFA en 2030, en el que está contemplado que Argentina albergue un partido. El 29 de julio, el presidente argentino, Javier Milei, publicó un decreto que modifica la ley migratoria para impedir el ingreso o expulsar personas extranjeras que difundan mensajes de odio o inciten a la violencia contra argentinos. Sin embargo, al 26 de agosto no hay registro de que el Gobierno argentino haya cambiado los requisitos de visa para ciudadanos mexicanos. La Embajada de la República Argentina en México dijo a Reuters en un correo electrónico del 21 de agosto que los ciudadanos mexicanos en calidad de turistas o que realicen actividades no remuneradas no requieren visa hasta por 90 días. Agregó que el Gobierno argentino no está trabajando en modificar dicha norma. No hay reportes creíbles en medios de comunicación sobre esta disposición. Un sitio de la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores de México (SRE) sobre Argentina dice que los requisitos de ingreso al país sudamericano no contemplan una visa para turista si la estancia es menor a 90 días. El Consulado General de Argentina en México enlista 10 distintos tipos de visa acorde con los motivos de viaje. En el caso de turista por un periodo de más de 90 días, la institución dice que se debe solicitar una extensión de la estadía vía correo electrónico con un periodo mínimo de 30 días a la fecha de viaje prevista, aunque no reporta su costo. La SRE no comentó sobre las publicaciones de la medida atribuida al Gobierno argentino. VEREDICTO Sin evidencia. La Embajada de Argentina en México dijo que su país no solicita visa de turista para ciudadanos mexicanos hasta por 90 días. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Nvidia leans into the danger of a bad-news spiral
item.description: The chipmaker’s hot streak persists, with revenue doubling to $96 bln. Yet investors value its immense cash flow at a discount. Customer backstops are a rising risk but wouldn’t consume the current gusher. If those promises are called, though, it’s likely to accompany a slowdown.
item.dc:creator: Karen Kwok
item.content:encoded: The AI boom has been very good to Nvidia (NVDA.O) boss Jensen Huang. These days, he’s trying to return the favor. The $5 trillion chipmaker’s products are still the gold standard for powering chatbots, with revenue more than doubling year-over-year to $96 billion for the three months ending in July 26, according to results unveiled Wednesday evening. Yet Nvidia increasingly underwrites this roaring demand through backstops and baroque financial engineering. So long as business keeps up, those promises look manageable. The risk is that bad news becomes self-reinforcing. For now, strong results continue apace. Free cash flow rose 59% from the prior year to $21 billion, adding firepower for Huang’s pledge to reserve at least 50% of cash generated for buybacks and dividends. Investors, though, have been somewhat reserved. When the market closed on Wednesday, Nvidia’s enterprise was valued at 43 times its trailing four quarters of free cash flow. That compares to rivals like Broadcom (AVGO.O) at 53 times and AMD (AMD.O) at 96 times, implying a meaningful discount. AMD, in particular, is expected to grow quickly, with Wall Street estimating it will nearly triple cash generation next year, according to Visible Alpha. Yet Nvidia’s anticipated growth at far larger scale is hardly less impressive. One creeping issue is that both established rivals like Broadcom and in-house silicon like OpenAI’s newly unveiled “Jalapeno” are poised to take an increasing piece of the AI pie. But Huang is also adding further risks. Nvidia has struck about $70 billion of direct equity investments as of August 17, including in AI labs like OpenAI and cloud operators such as CoreWeave (CRWV.O) that use its chips, according to Bank of America analysts' estimates. Meanwhile, commitments to backstop everything from collateral value in complex debt deals to data-center leases, as with an up-to $105 billion promise related to an OpenAI project with SoftBank-backed (9984.T) SB Energy, total as much as $230 billion. BofA analysts reckoned that, even in a worst-case scenario where Nvidia is forced to make good on a bunch of guarantees at once, it would only eat up 49% of free cash flow over the next two years. It is hard to imagine, though, that Nvidia’s results would not suffer at the same time. After all, many directly involve either its customers or the value of its chips. A simultaneous rise in committed payouts and a drop in sales might threaten Huang’s plans for sending cash back to shareholders. The same goes for his capacity to keep signing deals that keep the ecosystem humming, sending shock waves across the industry. Like an out-of-control AI model, bad news has a way of getting out of hand. Follow Karen Kwok on LinkedIn and X . Nvidia reported on August 26 that its second-quarter revenue roughly doubled year-over-year to $96 billion. As of Wednesday's close, the chipmaker's shares have risen by around 12% so far this year, while rival AMD's have more than doubled. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Big Ten extends contract of commissioner Tony Petitti to 2033
item.description: The Big Ten Conference announced Wednesday that commissioner Tony Petitti has agreed to a five-year contract extension, keeping him in the post through June 2033.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Big Ten Conference announced Wednesday that commissioner Tony Petitti has agreed to a five-year contract extension, keeping him in the post through June 2033. The Big Ten's council of presidents and chancellors unanimously approved the contract extension. Terms were not disclosed. "Tony has provided outstanding vision for the Conference through extremely turbulent times," Big Ten council of presidents and chancellors chair and Indiana president Pamela Whitten said in a statement. "We're thankful for his leadership and appreciate his spirit of innovation and collaboration as we continue to navigate the changing landscape of college sports." Formerly a deputy commissioner and CEO of Major League Baseball and top executive at MLB Network, Petitti became the seventh commissioner of the Big Ten in 2023. He replaced Kevin Warren, who left to become president and CEO of the NFL's Chicago Bears. The Big Ten has expanded to 18 members under Petitti's watch, as Oregon, Washington, Southern California and UCLA joined in 2024. On the field, the Big Ten has captured the last three national championships in football (Michigan in 2023, Ohio State in 2024 and Indiana in 2025) as well as this year in men's basketball (Michigan) and women's basketball (UCLA). --Field Level Media

item.title: Undrafted QB Tommy Castellanos commits to Texas Tech
item.description: In the wake of a recent court ruling, well-traveled quarterback Tommy Castellanos committed to Texas Tech on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: In the wake of a recent court ruling, well-traveled quarterback Tommy Castellanos committed to Texas Tech on Wednesday. Castellanos wasn't selected in the 2025 NFL Draft and participated in the Miami Dolphins' rookie minicamp as a receiver in May. However, a Kentucky judge granted a temporary injunction on Friday that gave 10 athletes, including Castellanos, a fifth year of NCAA eligibility. All of the plaintiffs are part of the high school Class of 2022, a group that wasn't covered retroactively in the NCAA's eligibility switch to five seasons over a five-year window. Castellanos has played four seasons -- one at UCF (2022), two at Boston College (2023-24) and last season at Florida State. He has passed for 6,449 yards and 48 touchdowns against 28 interceptions. Last season, He passed for a career-high 2,760 yards for the Seminoles while having 15 TD passes and nine interceptions. Castellanos also has rushed for 1,984 yards and 24 touchdowns. In 2023, he ran for 1,113 yards and 13 scores at Boston College. Texas Tech initially added Brendan Sorsby from Cincinnati to be its quarterback in 2026 but those plans were derailed by Sorsby's gambling issues and ensuing legal sparring with the NCAA and Big 12 over his eligibility. Sorsby eventually pursued the NFL supplemental draft but the league elected not to hold one. Will Hammond is expected to start Texas Tech's opener against Abilene Christian on Sept. 5. Hammond sustained a torn ACL last October and missed the rest of the season. Hammond has passed for 1,151 yards, nine touchdowns and five interceptions in two seasons with the Red Raiders. The Big Ten and Southeastern Conference enacted rules Tuesday that prevent players who have been with NFL teams from returning to college and playing for one of their programs. The Big 12 doesn't have such a rule as of Wednesday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Spurs win big and then draw Liverpool in League Cup
item.description: Tottenham Hotspur were rewarded with an away trip to Liverpool in the third round of the League Cup after thrashing Charlton Athletic 5-1 on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tottenham Hotspur were rewarded with an away trip to Liverpool in the third round of the League Cup after thrashing Charlton Athletic 5-1 on Wednesday. The clash was one of a possible six all-Premier League fixtures thrown up as the nine top-flight clubs playing in Europe entered the draw. Premier League champions Arsenal will travel to promoted Ipswich Town while holders Manchester City are at home to second-tier Norwich City. Manchester United will host Brighton & Hove Albion while Newcastle United, winners in 2025, are at Championship hopefuls Millwall after seeing off West Bromwich Albion 3-2 on Wednesday. Fleetwood are the sole fourth-tier side left in the competition and will host Sheffield United. The ties will be played in the weeks starting September 7 and 14.
